headline: ファージの溶菌タンパク質は、MurJの空洞に尾を差し込む
subhead: MurJとSglPP7の複合体を3.2 Åで解析。外向き型に固定され、脂質IIの輸送が止まると考えられる
target_en: E. coli MurJ with phage lysis protein SglPP7

summary.question: SglPP7はLysMと配列が似ないが、同じMurJを標的にするらしい。結合様式を調べる必要があった。
summary.approach: ナノディスクのMurJ/SglPP7複合体をクライオ電顕で解き、変異体解析とMDで補った。
summary.result: 3.2 Åで、SglPP7は膜貫通ヘリックス1本と短い尾から成り、尾（50–55番）がMurJの空洞に入っていた。
summary.learned: SglPP7はMurJを外向き型に安定化する。LysMやSglCJ3とは結合様式が違い、収斂進化と矛盾しない。
summary.open: MurJの溝に見えた脂質様の密度は、頭部が見えず、どの脂質か特定できなかった。

question.quote: recent genetic screening suggested that SglPP7, a 55-residue Sgl of Pseudomonas aeruginosa phage PP7, also targets MurJ
In contrast to LysM, SglPP7 is encoded at a distinct genomic position and shows no amino acid sequence similarity

approach.quote: reconstituted into nanodiscs with E. coli lipids, and its cryo-EM structure was determined at an overall resolution of 3.2 Å
Structural, mutational, and molecular dynamics (MD) simulation analyses revealed that SglPP7 binds along the intramembrane cleft of MurJ

result.quote: The modeled region of SglPP7 in each structure forms a single transmembrane helix followed by a short C-terminal tail that inserts deeply into a positively charged internal cavity
The C-terminal embedded tail (residues 50–55) inserts deeply into the positively charged interior of MurJ

learned.quote: these sequence-divergent Sgl proteins stabilize MurJ in the outward-facing conformation through distinct binding modes, consistent with the possibility of convergent evolution toward MurJ inhibition

open.quote: However, the map does not contain features corresponding to the hydrophilic headgroup of lipid II, precluding identification of its molecular species.

highlights.text: 尾のW53が鍵になる。W53KとW53Rでは溶菌活性が失われ、53番までの配列が残っていないと活性が出なかった。

evidence.quote: W53K and W53R lost lytic activity
retention of the sequence through residue 53 was required for lytic activity

highlights.text: 3つの溶菌タンパク質は、MurJの別の領域に結合する。尾が空洞を占めるSglPP7、表面に結合するLysM、溝に入るSglCJ3と、結合様式が異なる。

evidence.quote: Thus, the three Sgl proteins interact with different regions of MurJ through their C-terminal regions and stabilize MurJ in the outward-facing conformation through distinct binding modes characterized as cavity-occupying, surface-binding, and cleft-binding for SglPP7, LysM, and SglCJ3, respectively.

highlights.text: AlphaFold3はSglPP7の位置を予測できず、MurJも内向き型で予測した。実験で決めた構造が重要だと論文は述べる。

evidence.quote: failed to predict the experimentally observed positioning of SglPP7 on MurJ and showed low confidence in this region

lab_notes.expression: MurJとSglPP7を大腸菌BL21 ΔrecA (DE3)で共発現し、IPTGとアラビノースで誘導した。
lab_notes.purification: DDM・LMNG・CHSで可溶化し、Ni-NTAとSuperose 6 Increaseで精製した。
lab_notes.sample_prep: MSP1D1と大腸菌リン脂質を1.4:1:120で混ぜ、ナノディスクに再構成した。
lab_notes.data_collection: SPring-8のCRYO ARM 300で17,650ムービーを集め、cryoSPARCで処理した。

evidence.quote: Protein expression was induced with 1 mM isopropyl β-D-thiogalactopyranoside (IPTG) and 0.2% (w/v) L-arabinose.
N-terminally Met-His10-tagged SglPP71–55(WT) and Met-Ala-E. coli MurJ2–511
The protein was subsequently purified using Ni-NTA agarose resin (QIAGEN), followed by a Superose 6 Increase 10/300 GL column (Cytiva).
The purified MurJ/SglPP7 complex was mixed with MSP1D1 [31] and E. coli phospholipids (Avanti) at a molar ratio of 1.4:1:120
A total of 17,650 movies were aligned using patch motion correction

editor_notes: 別グループによる3.70 ÅのMurJ/SglPP7構造が既報（論文が本文で比較）。MD解析は短時間（120 ns×3）で、補助的な位置づけ。
